notes: The company's own job search renders client-side from its Azure Table Storage listing (nagcareersite.table.core.windows.net, Main/Split/Experience tables, continuation-token pagination). The served HTML has an empty #all-listings container plus the real filter markup: #expertiseField and #countryField dropdown-wraps, a #cityField that stays disabled until a country is chosen, and #keywordSearch (placeholder "Search Data, Java, Cloud...", min 3 characters). No filter/query parameters are sent to the table API - all filtering happens in the browser, and there is no page-number pagination (Load more per expertise group). Postings link out to the SmartRecruiters Nagarro1 board only for the detail body.
